scenario_toml:
# F2: freeze one instance with `docker pause` for 45 s, longer than the 30 s
# after which Depot fences a write handle without quorum progress. Repeats every
# two minutes on an instance picked with the seed.
name = "instance-pause"
seed = 42
duration_s = 300

[workload]
ledgers = 50
processes = 16
pacing_ms = [50, 200]
call_timeout_ms = 5000
agent_sessions = 10

[[nemesis]]
fault = "pause"
target = ["engine-1", "engine-2", "engine-3"]
at_s = 60
heal_after_s = 45
repeat_every_s = 120

[checks]
quiesce_s = 30
recovery_deadline_s = 300
